description: This Java class, ChargesHelper, provides utility methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting charge configurations in the Fineract API during integration testing. It includes methods to generate JSON payloads for different types of charges, handle API calls via a Fineract client, and manage charge data specific to loan, savings, client, and share accounts. The class is heavily annotated with deprecated comments indicating a transition away from direct use of server utility methods towards a client-based approach.

classes.name: ChargesHelper
classes.description: A utility class to manage charge creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion via Fineract API during integration tests. It contains methods for generating charge JSON payloads for different scenarios and interacts with the API through the Fineract client.

methods.name: createCharges
methods.description: Performs a POST request to create a new charge resource using the given request payload, returning the resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific charge by its ID through an API GET request.

methods.name: createLoanCharge
methods.description: Creates a new charge with a given payload and returns the response object.

methods.name: getCharges
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all charges via an API GET request.

methods.name: getChargeById
methods.description: Gets details of a charge specified by its ID.

methods.name: getChargeChanges
methods.description: Retrieves change history or specific change details for a charge ID.

methods.name: updateCharges
methods.description: Updates an existing charge by its ID with new data supplied in the request payload.

methods.name: deleteCharge
methods.description: Deletes a charge specified by its ID.

methods.name: getModifyChargeJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload to modify a charge's amount.

methods.name: getModifyWithdrawalFeeSavingsChargeJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for modifying a withdrawal fee savings charge.

methods.name: getModifyChargeAsPecentageAmountJSON
methods.description: Returns JSON to modify a charge with a percentage of amount calculation.

methods.name: getModifyChargeAsPecentageLoanAmountWithInterestJSON
methods.description: Returns JSON to modify a loan charge with percentage calculation including interest.

methods.name: getModifyChargeAsPercentageInterestJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to modify a charge with percentage interest calculation.

methods.name: getModifyChargeFeeFrequencyAsDaysJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to modify charge fee frequency as days.

methods.name: getModifyChargeFeeFrequencyAsWeeksJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to modify charge fee frequency as weeks.

methods.name: getModifyChargeFeeFrequencyAsMonthsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to modify charge fee frequency as months.

methods.name: getModifyChargeFeeFrequencyAsYearsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON to modify charge fee frequency as years.

methods.name: getChargeSpecifiedDueDateJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for a specified due date charge.

methods.name: applyCharge
methods.description: Performs a POST request to apply a charge specified by charge ID with a JSON payload.
